name: Pedestal TV list: VESA hole positions
how_to_use: Bottom edge of the TV on a stand = the stand's top hole height - (position - 1) * 2.5 cm - upper_hole_cm. Top edge = bottom edge + height_cm.

fields.name: Display name
fields.codes: Model codes covered by the row
fields.lower_hole_cm: Bottom edge of the TV to the centre of the lower VESA holes (cm); null when unknown
fields.upper_hole_cm: Bottom edge to the upper VESA holes = lower_hole_cm + vesa_h_mm/10 (cm); null when unknown
fields.source_type: measured | official | image | model3d | twin | reference | estimate
fields.source_label: Danish label used in the tool
fields.source: Where the value comes from (Which?, LG, Icecat, MediaMarkt, Elgiganten, LG-tegning 2023, Sonys måltabel, Samsung)
